is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 6, Results section).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports kdr mutation frequencies (Vgsc L995F/S) in Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 4, Methods; page 5, Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides sample sizes (2n) and kdr mutation frequencies (%) for 25 clusters.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in rural districts in the Plateau Department, Benin (page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study conducted in 2012.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for 25 specific villages/clusters in the Plateau Department, Benin (Table 1, page 4; Table 2, page 5).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted in 2012 (page 3, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary field study with new data collection.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study assessed the impact of LLINs on malaria prevalence and anaemia in children in 25 villages in Benin, while also measuring Anopheles gambiae s.s. susceptibility to deltamethrin and kdr mutation frequencies.
